reason: I do the billing myself every month, so I reckon I already know where most of the leakage is, and I'm not handing my PSA export and client contracts to a company with no customers, no reviews and no integration just because the audit is free. If it ever went past free, £240 a month for something I half-do in a spreadsheet already is a hard sell.
objection: Who are these people? No track record, no other MSPs I can ring for a reference, and they want my client data and contracts. A DPA is just paper if they fold in six months.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of MSPs my size I actually know, or someone in a peer group, telling me the audit found real money they billed and the clients didn't walk.
